page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre above the title; page number top left. Full-width title below the running head. Central woodcut emblem (framed engraving). Below the engraving, a centred four-line verse in italic. A small Greek catchword-like note at the lower right margin.

main_text.l: Sancta Themis, iustiq; tenax ter virgo beata,
Dispereat precor ille, tuæ, O Astræa, sacratum

page.notes: The engraving (woodcut emblem: a hand from a cloud holding a balance/chain, two serpents, a triangle with a plumb line, and a landscape with a sailing ship and scales on the ground) is not transcribed as text. The Greek word at lower right is set in the margin as a small catchword-like mark; it is given as a foot line. Verse lines are italic in the print; the long s is rendered as plain s.
